tables.title: RAG retrieval vs random retrieval
tables.about: Self-supervised from the AST call graph: for each function, the relevant chunks are those containing the functions it calls; the query is the function's own chunk.

tables.title: Supplementary comment usefulness evaluation (LLM judge)
tables.about: Blind, reference-free 1-5 ratings of the agent's and the human's comment on the same diff. Supplementary only: not a primary result.
notes: Limitations: a single LLM judge (possible self-preference and verbosity bias); small sample; the agent's comments are longer than human ones, which judges tend to reward; judge-human agreement must be measured with the human rating kit before citing.

definitions.name: ROC-AUC
definitions.definition: Probability that a randomly chosen positive case is scored above a randomly chosen negative one (Mann-Whitney U; ties count 1/2): ranking quality across all thresholds. 0.5 = chance.

definitions.name: BLEU-4
definitions.definition: Smoothed sentence BLEU-4 (Lin & Och 2004 +1 smoothing for n >= 2), averaged over samples, x100 (CodeReviewer convention).

definitions.name: ROUGE-L
definitions.definition: Longest-common-subsequence F1 of word tokens, averaged over samples, x100.

definitions.name: chrF
definitions.definition: Character 1-6-gram F-score (beta = 2, Popovic 2015), averaged over samples, x100.

definitions.name: Coverage
definitions.definition: Share of diffs for which the agent produced a comment.

definitions.name: Recall@10
definitions.definition: Share of a query's relevant chunks (its callees in the AST call graph) found in the top 10 retrieved; averaged over queries.

definitions.name: MRR
definitions.definition: Mean over queries of 1 / rank of the first relevant chunk.

definitions.name: Precision@Top10%
definitions.definition: Of the 10% of hunks ranked riskiest, the share a human reviewer commented on.

definitions.name: Rating
definitions.definition: Mean 1-5 rating by the LLM judge (supplementary).

scope: Agent-level benchmark evaluation of the Code Review Agent on its own. These numbers are not system-level results of the five-agent platform (SWE-bench Lite resolve rate), which is not built yet.
Configuration D (Static + LLM + RAG) is the shipped Code Review Agent; A-C are ablations that switch one component off.

Every value comes from a saved run in experiments/results/ (run ids are listed per row). A configuration without a valid run is N/A with the command that produces it. Runs made with the offline mock LLM test the pipeline and are never shown as results.
